items.name: Shuck Around and Find Out T-shirt | The Damp Clam Special
items.desc: This heavyweight, garment-dyed tee feels lived-in from the first wear. Soft, broken-in cotton drapes with a relaxed fit, letting the understated oyster-clam artwork breathe across the back and a small emblem on the chest. It’s built to last — double-needle stitching, tubular knit without side seams, and pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton mean the shape and color hold through wash after wash. Wear it to low-key seafood nights, coastal walks, or lazy weekends when you want something comfortable but a little salty and spirited.

items.name: Unisex Shuck Around and Find Out Hoodie
items.desc: The Gildan Heavy Blend™ hoodie, made from a soft cotton-poly blend, provides warmth and durability. Its unisex fit offers everyday versatility, with ribbed cuffs and hem to keep the shape intact. A large front pocket adds convenience, while the double-lined hood with matching drawcord gives it a clean, cohesive look. Trusted for custom printing and casual wear, the Gildan 18500 is a reliable choice that balances comfort and longevity.

items.name: The Damp Clam Trucker Mesh Hat
items.desc: This structured mid-profile trucker cap brings easygoing, outdoorsy style to everyday wear. The solid front panels and precurved permacurv® visor give it a clean silhouette, while the breathable mesh back keeps you cool on long drives, hikes, or backyard hangouts. Subtle stitched artwork on the front adds personality without shouting — it layers naturally over a hoodie, pairs with worn denim, and rolls up in a pack for weekend escapes. The adjustable snap closure lets you dial in a comfortable fit, and the cotton sweatband helps manage sweat during warm-weather adventures. Thoughtfully built with hard buckram front panels for shape retention and a branded sticker and sewn-in Yupoong label that speak to quality production.

items.name: The Damp Clam ceramic coaster | neon shell design
items.desc: A vibrant ceramic coaster featuring a playful neon-style clam illustration and “The Damp Clam” lettering on a deep navy background. The smooth, glossy ceramic top keeps colors bright while a cork backing prevents slips and protects surfaces from heat and condensation. Compact and easy to clean, this coaster brings a splash of seaside humor and retro arcade vibes to desks, coffee tables, or bar carts. It’s made from durable materials sourced from South Korea and holds both hot and cold drinks without staining, so it stays looking fresh through everyday use.

items.name: The Damp Clam Poker Playing Cards
items.desc: Shuffle light, deal slow. These poker playing cards bring bright, ocean‑tone artwork and crisp, classic face designs to every game night. The deck’s smooth 300gsm coated cardstock feels balanced in the hand and glides through shuffles. Each card is printed edge-to-edge with vivid inks that keep the colors lively round after round, and the set includes 52 standard cards plus 2 jokers tucked inside a clear acrylic box for clean storage. Use them at the table, carry them in a travel kit, or pull them out for a spontaneous round when friends gather — the clam artwork on the back adds a playful, seaside note to any game.

items.name: The Damp Clam Signature Shell Bikini
items.desc: This two-piece bikini brings a confident, playful energy to beach days and poolside lounging. Lightweight, stretchy fabric moves with you and holds vibrant printed art that stays bright after many wears. Removable padded liners let you customize coverage and shape, while adjustable tie straps create a flattering fit for sun-soaked afternoons, tropical getaways, or casual swims by the shore. The contrast trim and placement of the design add a bold, modern touch that reads as both fun and effortless.

items.name: The Damp Clam logo seashell, Swim Shorts | The drinks are stiff and so are we
items.desc: These mid-length swim shorts bring a cheeky, seaside bar vibe to your warm-weather rotation. Lightweight, stretchy fabric moves easily from the sand to the boardwalk. A bold clam graphic pops on one leg while a deadpan one-liner sits on the other — they read like a bartender’s wink and make conversation happen without trying. The soft inner mesh lining and elastic drawstring waist keep you comfortable whether you’re swimming, grabbing drinks after a surf, or lounging on a boat. Subtle, matched seam stitching and choice of black or white drawstrings keep the look clean and wearable.

items.name: If you can read this, Take me to The Damp Clam | Sublimation Crew Socks
items.desc: These crew-length sublimation socks bring soft warmth and bold, full-coverage design together. Lined with plush fleece at the sole, they cushion each step while the ribbed tube keeps them snug up the calf. The all-over print wraps the sock for a seamless look, with high-stretch polyester and spandex for shape retention and easy wear. Available in three sizes with cushioned bottoms and reinforced toe and heel pads, they slip into everyday routines — from long shifts and chilly commutes to relaxed weekends at home. Note: colors may vary slightly along side seams due to the flat sublimation print process.

items.name: Liquor Down Below Baseball Top | Short Sleeve Button Jersey
items.desc: This lightweight baseball top blends athletic performance with laid-back, coastal vibes. The soft grey body and white contrast taping give it a clean, vintage-inspired look, while the small chest emblem and larger back graphic add personality without shouting. Breathable pinpoint stretch mesh and a polyester/spandex build move with you, wick moisture, and resist odors—so it stays fresher through long practices, warm-ups, or weekend hangs. Subtle details like the double-needle hem and tag-free label keep comfort high and distractions low. Wear it to warm up, to run errands after a game, or to relax at a beachside bar — it settles into your routine and keeps you comfortable all day.

items.name: The Damp Clam Sipper Glass, 16oz
items.desc: Quench your thirst in style with our 16oz Sipper Glass. Made from clear tempered glass, it's durable, sleek, and perfect for refreshing cocktails, juices, or any beverage you fancy. Choose between the classic version or opt for the version equipped with a Gasket-push Bamboo lid and Tritan plastic straw for added convenience. This sipper glass is FDA Certified, BPA Free, and Cal. Prop 65 compliant, ensuring your safety and peace of mind with every sip.

items.name: Spiral Notebook - Ruled Line
items.desc: Shopping lists, school notes or poems - 118 page spiral notebook with ruled line paper is a perfect companion in everyday life. The durable printed cover makes the owner proud to carry it everywhere.

items.name: The Damp Clam Phone Tough Cases
items.desc: Personalize your iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, and Google Pixel devices with premium-quality custom protective phone cases. Every case has double layers for extra durability and protection while the clear, open ports stay out of your way when it comes to charging. The outer polycarbonate shell will resist daily impacts. Choose between matte or glossy finish and enjoy adding a unique touch to your phone with our custom protective phone cases sourced from Korea. New iPhone 17 series models now available!

items.name: Shucked daily, Loved nightly women's briefs
items.desc: Black-cut women’s briefs with a cheeky, tongue-in-cheek ocean theme. The front features a soft, pastel neon-style clamshell graphic with the playful phrase “THE DAMP CLAM,” while the back carries a curved, confident motto: “Shucked daily, Loved nightly.” The lightweight, two-sided fleece polyester feels smooth against skin and holds bright, saturated prints that won’t fade. Elastic waistband and delicate lace-trim edging keep the cut flattering and secure for everyday wear. These briefs bring humor and personality to a lingerie drawer — a little wink under your outfit that reads bold and fun when the moment calls for it.

items.name: The Damp Clam Cotton Canvas Tote Bag
items.desc: This 100% cotton bag comes in one size – 15" x 16"– perfect for everyday wear. While the canvas material will show off your designs in great colors, it's durable and will last for years. The bag features 20" handles (made from the same canvas), making it easy to carry even with a week's worth of shopping.

items.name: The Damp Clam Golf Balls, 6pcs
items.desc: Get your audience in the zone with these personalized golf balls. Available in budget-friendly six packs, these golf balls are made with 100% surlyn. Your artwork, photos, or names go on all six balls, in vivid detail and color.

items.name: Women's Ideal Racerback Tank - Shuck Around and Find Out
items.desc: A high-quality print of this slim fit tank-top will turn heads. Bystanders won't be disappointed - the racerback cut looks good on any woman's shoulders.
